primary_complete: All required points correct, semantically supported and cited to the correct version and locator, with zero unsupported published claims. On refusal: explicit source-bounded insufficiency, correct missing requirement, and no invented outcome.
latency_definition: Warm end-to-end wall time, including all searches, stages and failures. Use all attempted matched pairs, take median of B minus A per pair, and nearest-rank p90 for B. A systemic early stop is inconclusive.
invocation_definition: All application-stage attempts, including failures, times any actual attempts beyond A divided by net B-minus-A primary successes. A nonpositive gain does not qualify.
inconclusive_rule: Source judgments stay separate from operational failures. If a disputed reference or publication score can change a default gate under either defensible scoring, the default decision is inconclusive. Show both bounds; keep full 20 scheduled pairs visible.
decision: Default to B only if all thresholds pass. Keep A default with optional deep research when benefits concentrate in difficult cases or added cost exceeds the threshold. Keep manual selection when the evidence is mixed or inconclusive.
